phase_history.note: 74 unique active skills resolved; cluster analysis running
74 unique active skills characterized by 4 independent agents; 15 cross-cutting findings recorded

3 independent extractors x 4 skills = 12 contracts; 4 mergers; 4 independent audits (7 blocking issues found: 3 arithmetic in promotional-campaigns, 2 fact/scope in brand-design, 1 each in idea-validator and claude-md-guardian)

4 contracts frozen and leak-checked. Finaliser subagents hung twice on file writes; recovered by having them return JSON as reply text. brand-design contract required lead correction: the finaliser hallucinated placeholder hex values when cut off from source data; replaced with values verified directly from tailwind.config.ts, app/layout.tsx and pixel-sampling of the logo artwork (#F6841F confirmed over 614k pixels).
4 suites x 10 tasks (6 iteration / 4 sealed held-out). Ground truth verified by each designer. Held-out sets chmod 400 and never rendered.

models_verified.method: fresh subagent self-report per model alias

unavailable.claude-opus-4-8: NOT AVAILABLE - no model alias resolves to it; no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY present for direct model selection; ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL requires x-api-key we do not hold. Must not be claimed as tested.

blockers.title: Opus 4.8 condition cannot be run
blockers.detail: The Gauntlet spec requires condition 'Opus 4.8 + original skill'. Only claude-opus-5, claude-sonnet-5, claude-fable-5, claude-haiku-4-5 are reachable. Substitution requires explicit user approval; silent substitution is forbidden by the spec.
blockers.resolution: User approved substituting claude-sonnet-5 for the unavailable Opus 4.8 in condition A, on condition it is labelled a declared substitute everywhere and never presented as Opus 4.8.

selection_note: User replied 'no preference' to the slate question, delegating choice. Lead selected 4 spanning: retire-candidate (idea-validator), correctness-defect (claude-md-guardian), safety-critical business (promotional-campaigns), pure-durable-knowledge (brand-design).

A.label: prior-gen baseline (DECLARED SUBSTITUTE for Opus 4.8 - not Opus 4.8)

incidents.what: Subagent file-write path hung repeatedly (8 agents, ~50min lost)
incidents.mitigation: Agents now return artifacts as reply text; lead writes the files.

incidents.what: A finaliser invented brand hex values when denied source access
incidents.mitigation: Lead replaced with values verified from production config and artwork pixel sampling; independently re-verified.

incidents.what: Subagent write-hang recurred on 2 of 4 benchmark designers and cost ~2h across retries
incidents.mitigation: Established two reliable paths: write via Bash+python heredoc, or return JSON as reply text for the lead to write. Both now in use.
